blocks.text:
After breakfast, your English-speaking guide will meet you in the lobby. The tour lasts approximately **4 hours**.

First, head to Red Beach, where the cable car takes you up to Morro da Urca. The cabin quickly pulls away from the hillside, the houses grow smaller, and the bay with its boats opens up below. On Urca, you can pause at a restaurant or bar.

The second cable-car section takes you to Sugarloaf Mountain. From here, you can see Copacabana stretching along the Atlantic, islands, the Niterói Bridge and the bay. The statue of Christ stands on Corcovado, on the forested ridge opposite.

After descending, begin your tour of Rio de Janeiro's historic centre. Here, old churches, the cathedral, colonial facades and central streets take the place of ocean and mountain views. This part of the city recalls the time when Rio was Brazil's capital for more than a century and a half.

Return to your hotel after the tour.

blocks.text:
The ascent to Corcovado begins at the cog railway station. The train moves slowly through Tijuca Forest, with brief glimpses of the city between the trees. On steep sections, a special cog rail between the 2 ordinary rails keeps the train in place.

The forest comes close to the railway. You may spot birds and monkeys in the branches.

At the top stands the statue of Christ the Redeemer. The panorama is wider than from Sugarloaf Mountain: you can see Guanabara Bay, Maracanã Stadium, the Botanical Garden, the Niterói Bridge, the Atlantic coast and the neighbourhoods winding around the forested slopes.

Corcovado means different things to different visitors. Some spend time photographing the city; others experience the visit as a spiritual moment, pray or remain quietly for a few minutes.

After the tour, return to Copacabana Palace and relax.

**Excursion: helicopter flight over Rio de Janeiro**

Transfers are included in the price of this optional excursion.

Flights operate with a group of **at least 4 people**.

Prices start **from USD 150**.

The option flying around the statue of Christ lasts **9–10 minutes** and costs **USD 250 per person**.
